resources.string: Hold the bubble to ask about your screen
Turn on Buddy in Settings › Accessibility so it can see your screen
Couldn\'t read the screen — try again
Lets Buddy see the screen when you tap its bubble

When you tap or hold the Buddy bubble, Buddy takes a screenshot and reads the labels and positions of what is on screen, so it can answer your question and point at the right place. The screenshot is sent to Google\'s Gemini service to produce the answer and is not stored. Buddy never taps, types or changes anything on your phone, and does nothing while the bubble is idle.
Some phones stop overlays in the background. Disable battery optimization for Buddy for reliable use.
